PROSPECTUS SUMMARY The following summary is qualified in its entirety
by, and should be read in conjunction with, the more detailed information and financial statements included elsewhere in this prospectus.

construction and maintenance of aquaculture farms and related works. Our operations are based in Malaysia. Since our inception in 2020,
